unresolved_gaps: No representative, period-matched measurement establishes the combined assertion across generative AI software.
Task time and subjective workload measure different things; the retrieved results cannot be pooled into a general cognitive-load conclusion.
The financial component lacks an identifiable company, metric and accounting basis.
Neither study establishes that the reported effects arise inherently from the technology's design.
